common.comingSoonBody: This screen is described in docs/SPEC.md and will be built in a later stage.

dashboard.title: Welcome back
dashboard.subtitle: Working so far: map analysis and replay analysis. Pick a .osu file or one of your replays to start.
dashboard.subtitle2: Your week at a glance and what to train today, based on your replays.
dashboard.emptySubtitle: No plays yet. Set your osu! folders in Settings – new plays will appear here on their own.
dashboard.emptyHint: Point the app at your osu! folder (stable and/or lazer) and import recent replays, then calibrate sound latency for the exercises.
dashboard.streakHint: days in a row with a play or exercise

noData.title: Start with calibration
noData.why: There's no data yet. Calibrate sound latency, then do a single stroke at an easy tempo.

keyGap.title: Even out K2
keyGap.why: Over the last 14 days K2 is {{value}} ms off K1 on average. Isolate the weaker finger first.

keyGapEven.title: Single stroke, slower than usual
keyGapEven.why: Then alternate both fingers at {{bpm}} BPM and listen for an even gallop-free rhythm.

entry.title: Enter bursts on time
entry.why: You enter streams {{value}} ms off the beat on average. Bursts with a pause train the first tap.

streamUr.title: Streams are less even than the rest
streamUr.why: Stream UR is clearly worse than your overall UR. A burst ladder shows the tempo where it breaks.

fatigue.title: Stamina
fatigue.why: In most long sessions UR gets worse at the end. A short stream at a slightly lower tempo builds endurance.

maintain.title: Keep the routine
maintain.why: Nothing stands out right now – a short stream exercise keeps the hands in shape.

map.title: Map analysis
map.subtitle: Streams, stream blocks, 1/2 jumps and reading load of a single difficulty.
map.dropHint: …or drop a .osu file anywhere in this window
map.notOsu: This is not a .osu file. In osu! open the song folder (F3 → open song folder) and pick the difficulty file.
map.spacingHint: distance between notes ÷ circle diameter; 0 = stacked
map.blocksHint: streams separated by less than 1 second count as one block – this is what tests stamina
map.overlapHint: objects covered by a later, non-adjacent note before they disappear

replay.title: Replays & analysis
replay.subtitle: New plays from osu! appear here automatically. Every click is matched to its note: timing per key, streams, aim and misses.
replay.pickMap: Choose the map (.osu) this replay was played on
replay.dropHint: …or drop a .osr file (optionally together with its .osu) anywhere in this window

error.not-osr-file: This is not a .osr replay. In osu! press F2 on a score to export it, or open the Replays folder.
error.map-not-selected: The replay needs its map. Choose the .osu file of the same difficulty – the app will remember it.
error.map-mismatch: This map does not match the replay (different difficulty or an older version of the map). Choose the exact difficulty you played.
error.other-mode: This replay is from another mode. Only osu!standard is supported.
error.map-not-found: The map for this replay was not found in osu!.db or in Songs. Choose the replay again by hand to point at the map.
error.not-found: This replay is no longer in the history.

replay.urHint: 10 × standard deviation of your hit errors; lower = more even
replay.entryHint: average error on the first note of each stream
replay.alternationHint_one: {{count}} break – the same key twice in a row
replay.alternationHint_other: {{count}} breaks – the same key twice in a row
replay.tapSpreadHint: how unevenly the gaps between taps follow the rhythm
replay.aimDistanceHint: average click position, in % of circle radius
replay.overshootHint: + too far, − too short, % of radius · {{count}} jumps over 1.5 diameters
replay.missBreakdown: no click {{noClick}} · aim {{aim}} · notelock {{notelock}} · too early {{early}}
replay.judgedHint: 300 {{c300}} · 100 {{c100}} · 50 {{c50}} · miss {{miss}}; osu! judges sliders by ticks, so it can differ slightly
replay.footnote: Replay ends at {{replayEnd}}. Hit windows and circle size include mods (HR/EZ).

chart.byPosition: Average error by position in the stream
chart.byPositionHint: Hover a row for details. Bars growing to the right mean you fall behind the rhythm as the stream goes on.
chart.timelineHint: Hover a point for UR and misses. A marked point is where accuracy started dropping two sections in a row.

insight.partial: The replay ends at {{at}} (the map lasts until {{end}}), so the stats cover only the part you played.
insight.keyGap: {{later}} is on average {{diff}} ms later than {{earlier}}. Practice slow alternating on a metronome and listen for the weaker finger.
insight.streamDrift: The longer the stream, the more you fall behind: from {{first}} ms on the first notes to {{last}} ms on notes {{range}}. The tempo is running away – practice shorter blocks at this BPM before longer ones.
insight.streamUr: Streams are much less even than the rest of the map (UR {{stream}} vs {{outside}}).
insight.entryLate: You enter streams {{value}} ms late on average – the first tap of a burst comes after the beat.
insight.entryEarly: You enter streams {{value}} ms early on average – the first tap of a burst rushes ahead.
insight.miss_notelock: Most misses ({{count}} of {{total}}) are notelocks: you clicked the next note while the previous one was still waiting. Usually the cursor is already ahead while the tap comes late.
insight.miss_noClick: Most misses ({{count}} of {{total}}) had no click at all – in streams this means fewer taps than notes.
insight.miss_aim: Most misses ({{count}} of {{total}}) were clicked on time but with the cursor off the circle – this is aim, not tapping.
insight.miss_early: Most misses ({{count}} of {{total}}) came from clicking a circle far too early.
insight.fatigue: From {{at}} accuracy drops in two sections in a row. If you see this in other replays too, it's a good point to stop stream practice in a session.
insight.alternation: {{breaks}} alternation breaks in streams ({{percent}}% clean) – the same key pressed twice in a row.
insight.offsetLate: Overall you hit {{value}} ms late on average. If it's the same on other maps, consider adjusting your offset.
insight.offsetEarly: Overall you hit {{value}} ms early on average. If it's the same on other maps, consider adjusting your offset.
insight.overshoot: On jumps you overshoot by {{value}}% of the circle radius on average.
insight.undershoot: On jumps you stop short by {{value}}% of the circle radius on average.
insight.noIssues: Nothing clearly stands out in this replay.

history.title: History
history.empty: No replays yet. New plays are added automatically while the app is running – or import your recent ones.
history.importNothing: No replays from the last 30 days in: {{folders}}. Check the folders in Settings.

progress.title: Progress on this map
progress.needMore: Play this map at least twice to see a trend.
progress.hint: Each point is one attempt (filters above apply, e.g. only NM or only completed). Dashed line = trend. Click a point to open that attempt.

toast.mapNotFound: Map not found for {{file}}. Open it on the Replays screen to choose the map.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Where osu! is, which folders to watch for new replays and how the app starts.

osu.title: osu! folder
osu.notFound: not found – choose it by hand
osu.noDb: osu!.db not found – maps will be searched in the Songs folder
osu.dbError: Could not read osu!.db ({{error}}) – maps will be searched in the Songs folder
osu.hint: osu! updates osu!.db when the game closes. Maps downloaded in the current session are found by scanning the newest folders in Songs.

replays.title: Replays
replays.autoHint: Every new .osr in the folders above is analyzed and saved in the history while the app is open.
replays.notifyHint: A system notification when a new replay is analyzed while the app is in the background.
replays.importHint_one: Analyzes replays from the last 30 days that are not in the history yet. History: {{count}} replay.
replays.importHint_other: Analyzes replays from the last 30 days that are not in the history yet. History: {{count}} replays.

app.title: App
app.autostartHint: The app starts in the background after logging in, so no replay is missed.
app.autostartDev: Available in the installed version (not in npm run dev).

lazer.notFound: not found – choose it if you play lazer
lazer.hint: Lazer keeps maps and replays under hashed file names (files folder). The app recognizes them by their content and also catches failed plays saved by lazer.

keys.title: Keys & sound
keys.hint: Keys used in exercises – set the same ones as in osu!. Click a field and press the key.
keys.offsetHint: Set by calibration on the Rhythm screen; change only if you know why.

fps.hint: “Match monitor” draws once per screen refresh (like VSync in osu!). “Unlimited” draws as fast as the PC can (like Unlimited in osu!): a few ms less visual delay, more GPU load, possible tearing. Your hit timing is measured the same either way.
fps.restart: Takes effect after restarting the app.
fps.showHint: Shows frames per second and the longest frame in the corner of the drills.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Your replay measurements over time. Tiles compare the chosen period with the one before it.
stats.needMoreDays: Play on at least two different days to see a trend.
stats.byBpmHint: Maps grouped by the BPM of their streams. Look for the tempo where stream UR, K2−K1 or entry suddenly get worse – that is your current speed limit.
stats.computingBpm_one: Calculating stream BPM for {{count}} older play…
stats.computingBpm_other: Calculating stream BPM for {{count}} older plays…
stats.empty: No plays in this period with these filters.

drill.runningHint: Tap {{k1}} (L) and {{k2}} (P). Esc stops. The app only listens while this window is focused.
drill.noHistory: No results yet – finish an exercise to start tracking progress.
drill.tooShort: Too short to save in the history (fewer than 20 notes).
drill.entryHint: average error on the first note of each series
drill.wrongFingerHint: note played with the other key than the pattern says
drill.byPosition: Average error by position in the series

tip.keyGap: {{later}} is {{diff}} ms later than the other finger on average.
tip.drift: Within a series you fall behind: from {{first}} ms on the first notes to {{last}} ms at the end – lower the tempo a little and keep it even.
tip.wrongFinger: {{count}} notes played with the wrong finger – slow down until the pattern is automatic.
tip.extra: {{count}} extra taps – check that the key doesn't bounce (rapid trigger, actuation point).

rhythm.title: Rhythm & metronome
rhythm.subtitle: Finger exercises to a metronome: L = {{k1}} (K1), P = {{k2}} (K2), › = accent. Every tap is measured like in a replay.

calibration.title: Sound latency calibration
calibration.hint: Tap any of your keys exactly on {{beats}} clicks. The average delay is saved and applied to all exercises – do it once per headphones/speakers.
calibration.done: Saved: {{value}} ms. Exercises now compensate for it.

shiftAccent.name: Moving accent
shiftAccent.purpose: accent every 3 notes – independence, staying loose

trainer.title: Tap trainer
trainer.subtitle: Notes move to the line – tap {{k1}} (L, blue) and {{k2}} (P, orange). Hit error for each finger is shown below the lane.

modeHint.ladder: Bursts with a pause between them; the tempo rises every few bursts. Shows the BPM where your entry and evenness break.
modeHint.stream: Continuous 1/4 stream at one tempo – for stamina. Watch whether the error drifts later as you get tired.
modeHint.map: Every stream from the chosen map, in its real rhythm, with shorter breaks. Slow it down to learn, speed it up to overtrain.

trainer.noStreams: This map has no streams with that many notes.

sessions.title: Sessions & progress
sessions.subtitle: Plays and exercises grouped into sessions (a break over 45 minutes starts a new one). Shows warm-up and whether the end of a session gets worse.
sessions.warmupSlow: Slow start: first 3 plays UR {{first}}, the rest {{rest}} – a short warm-up exercise may help.
sessions.warmupOk: Warm start: first 3 plays UR {{first}}, the rest {{rest}}.
sessions.fatigueYes: Tired at the end: UR {{middle}} in the middle, {{end}} in the last part.
sessions.fatigueNo: No drop at the end: UR {{middle}} in the middle, {{end}} at the end.
sessions.fatigueSummary: {{tired}} of {{total}} long sessions get worse at the end. If it's most of them, try shorter sessions or more breaks.
sessions.warmupSummary: {{slow}} of {{total}} sessions start noticeably worse than they continue.

frame.title: Frame analyzer
frame.subtitle: Watch a replay note by note: approach circles, cursor trail, key presses and the judgement of every note. Jump straight to misses.
frame.pick: Choose a replay from the list.
frame.shortcuts: Space – play/pause · ←/→ – frame by frame · Shift+←/→ – 1 s · , / . – previous/next miss · [ / ] – previous/next 100/50/miss

error.not-found: This replay is no longer in the history.
error.files-missing: The replay or map file no longer exists on disk (moved or deleted), so its frames can't be shown. The saved analysis is still available on the Replays screen.

ai.title: AI connection
ai.subtitle: Let an AI (Claude, ChatGPT and others) see your measured data and act as your coach. Nothing is sent anywhere by itself – you decide what to share.

export.title: Export for AI
export.hint: A ready summary of your data in Markdown: skills, results by BPM, recent plays, detailed analysis of the latest ones and exercises. Paste it into any AI chat.
export.privacy: The export contains only measurements (no files, no account data). Read it before sending.

claude.title: Claude Desktop (MCP)
claude.hint: With MCP, Claude asks the app for data itself when you talk to it (e.g. “what should I train this week?”). The server runs only on your computer, only reads your history and starts with Claude Desktop – no extra installation.
claude.notFound: Claude Desktop not found – install it from claude.ai/download first (or copy the configuration by hand).
claude.installed: osu! Trener is in the Claude Desktop configuration.
claude.notInstalled: osu! Trener is not in the Claude Desktop configuration yet.
claude.added: Added. Fully quit Claude Desktop (also from the tray) and start it again.
claude.addFailed: Could not edit the Claude configuration ({{error}}). Copy the configuration and add it by hand.
claude.step1: Click “Add to Claude Desktop” (a backup of the previous configuration is kept).
claude.step2: Quit Claude Desktop completely and open it again.
claude.step3: In a new chat ask e.g. “Look at my osu! Trener data and tell me what to train this week.”

tool.get_profile_summary: skills summary for a period, comparison with the previous one, results by stream BPM, most played maps

others.title: ChatGPT and other AIs
others.hint: ChatGPT can connect to MCP servers only over the internet (HTTPS), so a direct connection will come with the online account (planned). For now use “Export for AI” above – it works with every chat.

roadmap.title: Skill roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: How osu! skills build on each other – from basics to complex skills. Click a skill for its description and how to train it, and mark where you are. Some skills are rated from your replays automatically (≈).
roadmap.polishOnly: Skill descriptions are currently available in Polish only.
roadmap.source: Based on “osu! phd chart” by {{author}}, corrected and extended. Skills / links:

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Goals are measured from your replays and exercises – no need to tick anything. A goal is reached when the average over the chosen window hits the target.
goals.fewSamples: fewer than 3 plays – not counted yet

hint.ur: Average UR of all plays in the window.
hint.k2k1: Average difference between your keys; the goal is reached when it's within ± the target.
hint.streamUr: Average UR inside streams (maps with streams only).
hint.entry: Average error on the first note of streams.
hint.accuracy: Average accuracy of all plays in the window.
hint.mapAccuracy: Best accuracy on the chosen map within the window.
hint.plays: How many plays in the window – for regularity.
hint.drills: How many finger exercises in the window.

plan.title: Plan & to-do
plan.subtitle: Your training plan: one-off tasks and tasks that repeat on chosen weekdays. Today's tasks also appear on the Dashboard.
plan.repeatHint: Without days the task is one-off. Repeating tasks reset every day they come back.

aim.title: Jumps – aim trainer
aim.subtitle: Circles appear like in osu!. Aim with your mouse or tablet and tap {{k1}}/{{k2}} (or click) when the approach circle closes. Measures timing, distance from the center and whether you overshoot or stop short.
aim.hint: Tip: for the closest feel to osu!, set the same CS and AR as your maps, and keep your normal sensitivity / tablet area.
aim.overshootHint: + too far, − too short, % of radius (along the jump)
aim.sidewaysHint: average distance to the side of the jump line, % of radius
aim.byAngleHint: distance from center on sharp vs wide jumps
aim.scatterHint: Every click relative to the circle, rotated so the jump always goes to the right →. A cloud right of the center = overshooting, left = stopping short. Red = miss.

patternHint.backforth: Two points, the axis changes every 8 jumps – clean back-and-forth aim.
patternHint.triangles: Triangles (~60° turns), rotated and moved around the playfield – the most common jump pattern in ranked maps.
patternHint.star: Star (pentagram): very sharp ~36° turns, every jump crosses the shape – snap aim.
patternHint.square: Squares (90° turns), rotated by 45° every lap.
patternHint.polygon: Any polygon – choose the number of corners.
patternHint.oibon: Edge-to-edge jumps across the whole screen, height drifts up and down.
patternHint.flow: Smooth curves and S-shapes with wide angles – flow aim. Works best up to ~2 diameters; beyond that the playfield forces tighter turns.
patternHint.random: Random jumps with sharp, wide or mixed angles.

aim.mapSearch: Search a map or mapper, e.g. Sotarks…
aim.mapHint: Jumps cut from a real map: positions and rhythm exactly as the mapper placed them. Type a mapper name to practise their patterns.
aim.mapNone: No maps with jumps in the library – set your osu! folders in Settings.
aim.mapMissing: The map file no longer exists (moved or deleted).
aim.mapNoJumps: No jumps this long in this map – lower “Jumps from”.

error.title: Something went wrong on this screen
error.body: The rest of the app works. Try again, or go back to the Dashboard. If it keeps happening, copy the text below and send it to the author.

library.title: Map library
library.subtitle: The maps you have in osu!stable and lazer, analyzed for streams, jumps and reading. Filter by parameters, pick maps for your level or build a ladder to a target map.
library.refreshHint: New maps are picked up at start-up; osu!stable adds them to osu!.db when the game closes.
library.empty: Set your osu!stable and/or osu!lazer folder in Settings – the app will analyze your maps in the background (a few thousand maps take about a minute).
library.starsHint: Stars come from osu!.db (osu!stable, no mods). Maps only in lazer have no stars, so a star filter hides them.
library.detail: {{objects}} objects · CS {{cs}} · {{pct}}% of objects in streams · longest stream {{notes}} notes, spacing {{spacing}} · average 1/2 distance {{dist}} diameters

profile.title: Your level
profile.hint: from your plays in the last 60 days (completed plays only)
profile.none: Not enough plays yet – the buttons below use sensible starting values.

preset.title: Pick maps for a goal
preset.speedWhy: Streams {{from}}–{{to}} BPM (you play evenly up to {{bpm}}), blocks no longer than {{block}} s – only the speed goes up.
preset.staminaWhy: Streams {{from}}–{{to}} BPM with blocks of {{min}}–{{max}} s (yours: {{block}} s) – same speed, longer.
preset.jumpsWhy: Jump maps with average 1/2 distance {{from}}–{{to}} diameters (yours: {{dist}}), few streams.
preset.readingWhy: AR from {{from}} (you usually play AR {{ar}}), stars up to {{stars}} – read faster without harder patterns.
preset.accuracyWhy: Easier maps, {{from}}–{{to}} stars, OD 8+ – aim for SS-level accuracy.

ladder.title: Ladder to: {{map}}
ladder.missing: Map not found in the library.
ladder.none: Not enough similar maps in your library for a ladder – download a few maps in a similar style.

basis.streams: Steps chosen by stream tempo, block length and stars – from your level to the goal.
basis.jumps: Steps chosen by jump distance, jump density, AR and stars – from your level to the goal.
basis.general: Steps chosen by stars, AR and BPM – from your level to the goal.
